thread:
maria_support: FYI a customer hit a 413 from /v1/rerank. Their payload: long query + ~120 docs, each ~6-9k chars. Error returned only: '413 Request Entity Too Large'. They want a clear next step.
aj_dev: Can you paste the request (redact PII) + curl so I can repro locally? Also, roughly how many tokens/chars did they report? :eyes:
maria_support: Here's the sanitized repro they gave (removed doc bodies):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query":"<long customer query here>","docs":["<doc1 body removed>","<doc2>", ... ]}'
```
They said the request payload was ~2.1MB and that the service just returned 413 with no detail.
kevin_engineering: Quick note: rerank enforces a combined size cap on the request body (query + all docs). When that cap is exceeded we return 413 from the edge, but we haven't been surfacing the specific field (e.g., "docs_count" or combined_bytes) in the error. That makes triage painful.
kevin_engineering: Suggested immediate mitigations for customers:
- Pre-filter with embeddings / vector search to reduce candidate set before calling rerank.
- Truncate/summary long docs on client side (or send only snippets).
- Batch docs into multiple rerank calls (rank top N per batch then merge).
- If docs are large, send metadata + excerpt rather than full text.
sam_research: For reproducible test: try sending the same shape but with 40 docs of similar size; that should hit the cap faster and help us repro. Also we should add a unit test that constructs multi-doc payloads with increasing sizes.
maria_support: Customer would prefer we handle it server-side with a clearer error and suggested recovery steps in the message. They found the bare 413 confusing.
aj_dev: Agreed — UX ask: include a short JSON body like { "error": "limit_exceeded", "reason": "combined_request_size", "max_bytes": 1048576 } and a human-friendly message with suggested fixes. Product to confirm exact field names.
kevin_engineering: I'll file an engineering ticket to change the edge behaviour to include an error JSON and a metric. Also will add logging that emits the combined bytes and docs_count (redacted) to our internal error telemetry so we can correlate without exposing content.
ops_bot: deploy-bot: created issue RED-3951: "Rerank 413: informative error + telemetry" assigned to eng-runtime. Link: https://issues.redwood.ai/RED-3951
sam_research: Small note: we should also document recommended pre-filter thresholds in the docs (e.g., prefer rerank with <= 50 docs or total payload < 1MB) — numbers TBD after experiments.
maria_support: I asked the customer for a redacted payload and permission to attach a sample to the ticket. They replied they'll redact and send within the hour. :thumbsup:
aj_dev: Once we get the redacted sample, I'll try the multi-batch workaround and share a short code snippet customers can use to split and merge results.
kevin_engineering: Triage plan: 1) repro with the provided sample, 2) add unit tests, 3) change edge error body, 4) ship docs update and notify support. ETA: early next week.
maria_support: Thanks — I'll update the customer with the workaround (pre-filter or batch) and let them know we're tracking an improvement request. Will post the redacted payload here when they send it. :eyes:
